dedupe_keys.name: les pistes et bandes cyclables de la ville de saint denis

description: Les pistes et bandes cyclables de la Ville de Saint-Denis is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data de La Réunion, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Mairie de Saint-Denis. Représentation des pistes cyclables sur la commune de Saint-Denis. Jeu de données distribué en Open Data par la Direction du Plan et du SIG de la Mairie de Saint-Denis. Coverage: La Réunion. The portal files it under Aménagement durable du territoire, Transports et déplacements. Its keywords are velo. The portal shows 48 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-02-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-regionreunion-com-portal.
